title: Fraunhofer Prototype
abstract: Help hybrid teams plan their office week and get AI feedback on how they work together. The WORK:AI:TION team (Tjark, Victoria, Rouben and Lisa) built this web app during the Fraunhofer Summercamp 2025, with a FastAPI backend, prompt templates that turn survey data into AI insights and a plain HTML frontend.
highlight: The prototype won the awards for best UX, transferability and scalability potential.

demos.alt: Team measures view with AI feedback
